clinical_trial.snippet: This prospective, multicenter clinical validation study was conducted at 4 US investigational sites.
Study enrollment was conducted from August 2018 to October 2020.
A total of 614 lesions from 394 participants were enrolled among the 4 study sites.
This study received IRB approval from the Western Institution Review Board /C210(Protocol CSP-18-0001).
The approval follows an observational study (NCT05126173) that evaluated the device in over 1000 patients and was led by the Mayo Clinic.
